## Hypothesis

We need to establish the baseline performance of the current engine on J's source-of-truth anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04 winners; 5/05, 5/06, 5/07 losers) to measure edge_capture per OP-16. This Stage-1 backtest will quantify current engine P&L on these days using simulated OPRA fills, providing the foundation for evaluating future strategy changes.

## Mechanism

Run the current engine (heartbeat.md + params.json) over the full available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with realistic OPRA fill simulation (using cached real bid/ask data). Extract per-trade P&L for each J anchor day, separating winners and losers. Validate top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) by cross-checking simulated fills against actual OPRA trade logs where available.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Uses current params.json (Safe-2 account ~$2K, Bold-2 ~$1.65K). For headline scaling: $1K paper account ≈ 14% of headline P&L (per playbook risk rules).
2. **Sample bias:** Extremely small sample (n=6 J days) with high overfit risk. Selection method: fixed anchor days per OP-16 doctrine. Not representative of general market regimes.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (this is a baseline measurement; OOS validation requires separate walk-forward test).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J day validation pending simulated OPRA fill comparison).
5. **Failure modes:** Look-ahead bias in level detection, incorrect strike selection, simulator slippage model mismatch, OPRA cache gaps causing fill inaccuracies.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will compute top-5 days % of total P&L after backtest completion).
